ai_research_governance_definition.description: AIRGD (AI Research Governance Definition) defines the AI-research-specific governance delta for research questions, prior work, novelty claims, hypotheses, counter-hypotheses, falsification, research design, evidence conditions, run lineage, evidence-to-claim linkage, negative result preservation, replication, research repair, rerun, revision, and publication-claim consistency. It references parent governance and sibling domains without reimplementing their judgment logic.

domain_scope.scope_statement: govern AI research claim readiness and lineage by preserving the relationship between research question, prior work, novelty, hypotheses, falsification, research design, evidence artifacts, runs, results, claims, limitations, replication, and research revision

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: keep AIRGD rules focused on abstract AI research governance rather than case-specific research topics, tools, institutions, or workflows

role_complete_separation.principle: AIRGD emits AI-research-domain findings about research claim readiness and lineage; it does not own parent governance, sibling domain logic, external orchestration, approval authority, or implementation execution authority.

separation_targets.source_material: prior work, observations, datasets, model references, prompts, code references, run outputs, and publication drafts used as inputs; source content is not absorbed as AIRGD rules
separation_targets.domain_definition: AIRGD-specific rules for research question, prior work, novelty, hypothesis, falsification, research design, evidence-to-claim, replication, and revision
separation_targets.inherited_governance: ARGD and DAGD mechanisms referenced as authoritative context and not re-expanded
separation_targets.sibling_reference: other domain definitions referenced only when their specific concerns affect research claim readiness
separation_targets.governed_target: AI research claim, research object, research lineage, and publication claim consistency
separation_targets.domain_evaluation: AIRGD evaluation axes for research claim governance only
separation_targets.domain_repair: AIRGD repair origins for research object and claim lineage failures only
separation_targets.activation: local applicability signals for AI research governance only
separation_targets.status_reporting: domain-local research claim and lineage status only
separation_targets.records: minimal material AIRGD records for research process and evaluation/replication/repair linkage
separation_targets.external_orchestration: routing, registry, priority, and domain selection remain external
separation_targets.metadata: identity, authorship, license, repository, version, and consecutive information only

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: prevent AIRGD from becoming an all-in-one AI research execution, statistics, implementation, artifact-quality, security, or authority governance definition

research_object_model.purpose: define AIRGD-local research objects and relationships without becoming a complete project, execution, statistics, software, security, or publication artifact model

research_intent_and_question_intake.purpose: fix the research intent and candidate research question without collapsing materially different questions

scope_objective_and_significance_definit.purpose: define research scope, non-scope, target system, population, and significance

prior_work_collection_and_mapping.purpose: map prior work with citation identity, reading status, relation, and limitations

gap_and_novelty_analysis.purpose: define known work, gap, novelty type, overlap, difference, uncertainty, and overturn conditions

hypothesis_and_counter_hypothesis_defini.purpose: define hypotheses, counter-hypotheses, observable implications, and discriminating evidence

falsification_and_overturn_condition_def.purpose: bind falsification targets, disconfirming evidence, alternative interpretations, and overturn conditions

research_experiment_design.purpose: define research design sufficient to test or probe the hypotheses without taking ownership of statistical or software implementation details

evidence_artifact_identity_binding.purpose: bind data, model, prompt, code, environment, or other artifacts as research evidence conditions without governing their detailed quality

baseline_control_and_ablation_applicabil.purpose: record whether baseline, control, or ablation is required for the intended claim and how missing comparison affects claim scope

evaluation_plan_and_metric_binding.purpose: bind evaluation targets and metrics as research evidence conditions while referencing sibling domains for detailed statistical or modeling validity

experiment_execution_lineage_capture.purpose: capture run lineage and execution outcome needed for research evidence without implementing agentic or software execution governance

run_validation_and_artifact_verification.purpose: verify that the run corresponds to the declared evidence artifacts and design conditions

result_interpretation_and_uncertainty_bo.purpose: separate raw output, measured result, interpretation, uncertainty, failed run, and negative result

hypothesis_evaluation.purpose: evaluate hypotheses and counter-hypotheses under the bounded results without collapsing inconclusive outcomes

research_claim_construction.purpose: construct research claims from bounded evidence, scope, uncertainty, and limitations

limitation_and_failure_analysis.purpose: preserve limitations, negative results, failed runs, untested assumptions, and failure modes

reproduction_or_replication_condition_tr.purpose: track reproduction or replication state and impact on claim confidence without treating failure as automatic refutation

research_governance_audit.purpose: audit AIRGD-specific research claim governance, boundary preservation, and critical invalidation conditions

research_repair_rerun_or_revision.purpose: identify the earliest valid AIRGD repair origin and preserve parent lineage through repair, rerun, or revision

publication_claim_consistency_and_status.purpose: report whether publication claims match validated research claims and whether review or handoff conditions exist

evaluation_policy.scoring_reason: AI research claim governance requires dimension-level readiness and invalidation checks to prevent claim overreach and lineage loss.
evaluation_policy.severity_reason: AI research failures can invalidate specific claims or publication readiness even when other dimensions are stable.

repair.purpose: define AIRGD-local repair origins and affected-scope revalidation for AI research claim governance without replacing parent repair governance

replication_and_reproduction.purpose: track reproduction and replication only as they affect research claim confidence and lineage

research_revision.purpose: preserve research version lineage when questions, hypotheses, experiments, metrics, claims, or publication mappings change

ai_research_process_record.purpose: record the minimum AIRGD material chain from research question through claim and lineage

research_evaluation_replication_and_repa.purpose: record AIRGD evaluation findings, replication impact, repair conditions, and governance state
